name: steam-deal-radar
description: Steam 折扣雷达 — 自动刷新、离线可查、关注提醒的跨平台 Steam 打折追踪器

scripts.build: npm run build -w @radar/core && npm run build -w @radar/ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @radar/core && npm run typecheck -w @radar/ui && npm run typecheck -w @radar/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run dev -w @radar/desktop
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run dist:linux -w @radar/desktop
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist:win -w @radar/desktop
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run dist:dir -w @radar/desktop
